item.title: This Wisconsin musician shared the NFL halftime show stage with Snoop Dogg
item.description: One Wisconsin musician knows what it’s like to be a part of a hugely choreographed musical production like the Super Bowl halftime show. In December, French horn player Alexander Henton got the call to be a part of “Snoop Dogg’s Holiday Halftime Party.” The post This Wisconsin musician shared the NFL halftime show stage with Snoop Dogg appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Workarounds can ease trade wars’ impact on small businesses at Twin Ports
item.description: As international trade through the Port of Duluth-Superior drops sharply, an adviser points to tools like foreign trade zones and smarter shipping strategies. The post Workarounds can ease trade wars’ impact on small businesses at Twin Ports appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin lawmakers explore age verification requirements on companionship chatbots
item.description: As a proliferation of free and easy artificial intelligence tools transform how people learn, work and socialize, Wisconsin lawmakers heard testimony Wednesday on a proposal that seeks to regulate kids’ use of human-esque chatbots. The post Wisconsin lawmakers explore age verification requirements on companionship chatbots appeared first on WPR.

item.title: More than 900K tons of food waste ends up in Wisconsin landfills, report finds
item.description: The state wants residents to cut their food waste in half as more than 900,000 tons of wasted food and scraps ended up in Wisconsin landfills in 2024, making up 20 percent of all trash. The post More than 900K tons of food waste ends up in Wisconsin landfills, report finds appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Rockwell Automation selects New Berlin for ‘factory of the future’
item.description: Rockwell Automation has selected New Berlin as the home of a new manufacturing plant, the company announced in an earnings call Thursday. The post Rockwell Automation selects New Berlin for ‘factory of the future’ appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Lawmakers approve $10M for western Wisconsin mental health and treatment facility
item.description: Wisconsin lawmakers have released $10 million to help construct a new mental health and substance abuse treatment center in western Wisconsin. The post Lawmakers approve $10M for western Wisconsin mental health and treatment facility appeared first on WPR.

item.title: State finance committee approves bill to fund homeless veterans support
item.description: The bill would provide more money for care and support of veterans at nonprofits, but wouldn't provide the state VA with the means to reopen closed housing facilities in Green Bay and Chippewa Falls. The post State finance committee approves bill to fund homeless veterans support appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Milwaukee County Board approves new health care contract following lapse
item.description: Milwaukee County officials approved a new health care contract for employees and retirees on Thursday, just days after they learned that the old contract had expired at the end of last year. The post Milwaukee County Board approves new health care contract following lapse appeared first on WPR.
